turns.content: I’ve reviewed all 251 quiet contracts. Repeat-offender relapses are the strongest historical setup here; I’m retaining a broad 80-coin shortlist to check whether recent funding dips are persistent or just isolated noise. The announcement feed mostly shows pair removals, which I’m not treating as proof that a coin is entirely delisted or unborrowable.

The review covered 96-hour paths for 80 candidates and 45-day histories for 30. I’m ranking mainly for relapse depth, with two emerging activity setups, ZBT and DIA. Hit probabilities remain below 50%: historical quiet repeat-offender cohorts hit about 29–38%, and several candidates still show falling dollar OI or only intermittent funding pressure.
